intent: Searchable command menu for quick actions.
useWhen: Command palette — kit Button opens kit Modal with Command inside
doNotUseWhen: Actions from a button — use DropdownMenu
Overlay chrome — compose Modal; do not add CommandDialog

groups.note: Each group has optional heading and a required items array. Item icon is a Lucide PascalCase name from the catalog.

label.note: Accessible name on the combobox input

requirements: Input is role=combobox with aria-expanded=true, aria-controls the listbox, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-activedescendant, and aria-label from label
Items are role=option with aria-selected when highlighted and aria-disabled when disabled

doNot: Do not invent CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandSeparator, CommandShortcut, or CommandDialog
Do not wrap the search field in Field — Command owns its input
Do not use kit Input (uncontrolled) for the query
Do not use cmdk or extra dependencies
Do not close itself — compose Modal for an overlay
snippet:
<Button variant="secondary" iconStart="Search" onClick={open} />
<Modal open={open} title="Command menu" onClose={close}>
  <Command groups={groups} onSelect={close} />
</Modal>
